text.03-programme-cognitive-science:
Subjects carry no minimum grade unless one is shown. The averages at the end decide your quota.

Any IB English
Danish requirement: English B
Any IB Maths
Danish requirement: Mathematics B

And one of these:

History (SL or HL)
Danish requirement: History B or Contemporary History B
Global Politics HL, or Global Politics SL with Economics
This is Aarhus University's own rule; the national table publishes no IB equivalent.
Danish requirement: Social Studies B
History of Ideas B: no IB route
The handbook publishes no equivalent for this subject. The other options are the way in.
Danish requirement: History of Ideas B

To be ranked in quota 1:

Quota 1: at least 28 IB points
Below this, you can still be admitted in the other quota.
Danish requirement: Quota 1: an average of 6.0

How these requirements read in IB terms

Where no grade is shown, no minimum grade is recorded for that subject.

Maths HL (AA or AI)
At least a 3 (an IB 3 converts to 02, the lowest that reaches 02).
Danish requirement: Mathematics A, minimum 02
Any IB English
At least a 3 (an IB 3 converts to 02, the lowest that reaches 02).
Danish requirement: English B, minimum 02

And one of these:

Physics (SL or HL)
At least a 3 (an IB 3 converts to 02, the lowest that reaches 02).
Danish requirement: Physics B, minimum 02
Geoscience A: no IB route
The official handbook leaves the IB column blank for Geoscience A. IB Geography HL is not automatically accepted; you would normally need a Danish supplementary course. The other options are the way in.
Danish requirement: Geoscience A, minimum 02

And one of these:

Chemistry (SL or HL)
At least a 3 (an IB 3 converts to 02, the lowest that reaches 02).
Danish requirement: Chemistry C, minimum 02
Biotechnology A: no IB route
The handbook publishes no equivalent for this subject. The other options are the way in.
Danish requirement: Biotechnology A, minimum 02
